svg.title: P26: Session-tree version control collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A3 · tree role collaboration
Execution history can be checkpointed and
A fork, checkout, rewind, or restore is requested
Node identity, ancestry, checkpoint payload, and
The new branch starts from the requested stable
Event boundary is stable and enough state
New branch records parent, boundary, and
External side effects are not rolled back
and must be reported as irreversible.
1 append(node) → 2 checkpoint(node) → 3 fork(node) → 4 snapshot(branch) → 5 create(branch) → 6 restore(checkpoint) → 7 resume(tree)
Evidence: 32/41 repositories, 30/36 families; 32 trajectories (15 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Transcript fork, session copy, Git-style checkpoint, event UUID branch, and rewind.
Negative control: Workspace checkpoint without conversation branching is only partial.
